_about: Locations a storefront or its publisher ecosystem manages, rather than the game.
Thin on purpose. Most storefronts impose no save convention at all -- that finding is
recorded in KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md section 9 -- and the ones that do mostly key their
folders by an identifier NOVARA does not carry in its template variable set:
needs {UBISOFT_ID}; without it only the shared parent is
expressible, and binding that would archive every Ubisoft game
Naming a shared parent would be worse than omitting it, so those are left out until
the variable exists. See the Track G report.

entries.note: Folder the EA ecosystem manages across its catalogue
